name: Final Angular Velocity
description: Calculates final angular velocity under constant angular acceleration.

name: Angular Displacement
description: Calculates angular displacement under constant angular acceleration over a given time.

name: Final Angular Velocity Squared
description: Relates final and initial angular velocity to angular acceleration and displacement, independent of time.

name: Arc Length (Linear Displacement)
description: Relation between linear displacement (arc length) and angular displacement.

name: Linear Velocity
description: Relation between linear (tangential) velocity and angular velocity.

name: Tangential Acceleration
description: Relation between linear (tangential) acceleration and angular acceleration.

name: Centripetal Acceleration (Linear)
description: Centripetal acceleration expressed in terms of linear velocity and radius.

name: Centripetal Acceleration (Angular)
description: Centripetal acceleration expressed in terms of angular velocity and radius.
